findings.text: eCFR supplies the codified FAR Part 10 baseline, while Acquisition.gov separately publishes the RFO model text.
The posted GSA deviation is the source that supplies agency-specific adoption, scope, and timing in this test record; the model text alone does not.
The related proposed rule remains part of the formal rulemaking pipeline and is not treated as current codified policy.

validation.executive_summary: Published sources must be read as separate layers. eCFR provides the codified baseline, the FAR Council model text is not agency-operative by itself, the posted GSA deviation supplies agency-specific scope and timing, and the proposed rule remains non-operative rulemaking evidence.
source_hierarchy: Codified eCFR text is the baseline reflected in the electronic Code of Federal Regulations. [E001]
The agency deviation controls the documented agency-adoption analysis within its stated scope and timing. [E003]
RFO model text, proposed rules, guidance, and comments remain distinct supporting layers. [E002, E004, E005]
